children: Overview
US Ethereum/AI infrastructure firm's Q3 revenue fell 11% yr/yr, missing analyst expectations
Company returned to profitability in Q3 with net income of $28.5 mln, or $0.08 per share
Colocation revenue rose 232% yr/yr as company shifted focus from bitcoin mining
Outlook
Company does not intend to sell WhiteFiber shares in 2026, viewing them as a long-term asset
Company expects capital allocation to continue shifting toward Ethereum and infrastructure-related opportunities
Bit Digital does not expect to allocate meaningful growth or maintenance capital to bitcoin mining
Result Drivers
COLOCATION GROWTH - Colocation revenue increased 232% yr/yr, driven by the MTL-3 site becoming fully operational and initial revenue from the NC-1 facility
BITCOIN MINING WINDDOWN - Revenue from digital asset mining fell sharply as the company continued to reduce exposure to bitcoin mining

ETH STAKING REPOSITIONING - ETH staking revenue declined yr/yr due to repositioning ETH into liquid staking to collateralize WhiteFiber financing, though sequential revenue improved with higher ETH prices
